source: Owner request 2026-11-20: basic triggers (EMA 13 crosses, MACD, RSI, volume) and the EMA 13 snap-back with EMA 13 as a moving target.

strategies.name: Volume surge up-day
strategies.entry: volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20) and close > open and close > high[1]

strategies.name: EMA 13 snap-back (long): stretched below EMA 13, reversal starts, target = EMA 13
strategies.entry: lowest(low - ema(close, 13), 3) < -$k * atr(14) and close > high[1] and close < ema(close, 13)

strategies.name: EMA 13 snap-back (short): stretched above EMA 13, reversal starts, target = EMA 13
strategies.entry: highest(high - ema(close, 13), 3) > $k * atr(14) and close < low[1] and close > ema(close, 13)
